g.text: C. Producer main wall time (three tools per task)
Milliseconds per task; medians and observed min/max; all negatives retained
Thread-only and tokenizer-only controls, exact decode/token work, owner CPU and all phase timestamps are retained in CSV.
Unchanged work with longer wall localizes a phase; it does not identify a GPU, frequency or scheduler cause.
Bars show independent group medians; paired differences in the report may have a different ordering.
